next.reason: 1985: "The last statement in a declarative section when the paragraph in which it appears is not being executed under the control of some other"; 2023: "In the declarative section for a fatal exception condition, there is no next executable statement after either the last statement". 2023 keeps the no-next-statement case only for declaratives of fatal exception conditions, and adds abnormal run unit termination unless the exception occurs in SORT, MERGE or certain I-O.
